Definition: Annual standard deviation of daily discharge.
Coefficient of variation, calculated as annual SD divided by MEAN.
Annual interquartile range, calculated as the 75th minus 25th percentile of daily discharge.
Annual minimum of the trailing 7-day mean discharge, calculated over the full daily record before selecting yearly extrema.
Annual maximum of the trailing 7-day mean discharge, calculated over the full daily record before selecting yearly extrema.
Corresponding non-exceedance percentiles of daily discharge within each year.
Annual Gini coefficient of daily discharge. Zero denotes equal daily values, while larger values indicate concentration in fewer days.
